entries.title: Production civic login compatibility repaired
entries.summary: Production civic login was repaired after Cloudflare's PBKDF2 runtime limit proved incompatible with the stronger iteration count retained by the migrated Founder account. The portal now provides a certificate-backed, one-time credential upgrade that securely re-derives the existing password at the supported iteration count without storing or exposing plaintext credentials. The account remains private, Editorial Studio and analytics remain restricted server-side to the Founder's authorized civic profile, and all 65 release tests passed before publication.

metadata.passwordStorage: PBKDF2 derived hash only; plaintext never retained
changes: Production login no longer fails with a Worker runtime exception
Existing password preserved through secure re-derivation
Editorial Studio and analytics remain Founder-only
Updated Worker and public login interface published
